# Illuminated letters / neon letters: Here you can get the “Symbols and letters” blueprint

![Luminous letters / neon letters: Here you can get the blueprint “Symbols and letters”](/uploads/339_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

The **Symbols and Letters blueprint** is one of the most sought-after plans when it comes to CAMP construction. Many also call the blueprint **Light Letter Set** or **Neon Letter Set**.

The blueprint is not difficult to obtain, but it is relatively expensive compared to other blueprints.

**Price: 9900 Bottle Caps**

(without charisma bonus or perks)

## Dealer with the "Symbols and Letters" blueprint

The blueprint is only available from the following dealers:

- Brotherhood Merchant (Whitespring Mall)
- Raiders Dealer (Whitespring Mall)
- Merchant Bot Phoenix (Watoga Mall)
- Raider Trader Bot (Sutton Station / Pleasant Valley Station / Sunnytop Station / R&G Station)
- Dealer Bot Resin (Pleasant Valley Ski Resort)

The illuminated letters / neon letter set is also available from:

- Grahm (Traveling Super Mutant Trader)

However, these retailers do not always offer the plan. The chance of the plan being on offer is between 15-20%. So if you search these dealers on a server, you have a relatively high chance of finding and buying the plan.

You can read here how you are guaranteed to find Grahm: Grahm Route & Offers: How to find him immediately (Supermutant dealer)
